intent.goal: find stories related to international launch

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE (
    u.database_name IN ('stories', 'journal', 'cpj')
    OR (u.database_name = 'gmail' AND g.page_id IS NOT NULL)
)
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%international%' 
    OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%launch%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;

sample_results.message_content: https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66ecd6dc05237c055808bf92/68df183ecab22085a93231a6_2025-10-02-1709-48-xai-data-center-wide-shot.webp Gratitude lets you create acceleration when there’s none & the responsibility of the privelaged margenalized 2025-10-02: This is a living article and I will update it at my desecration. Right now it’s hot off the press and likely jagged and meandering. Enjoy. **Gratitude is an OP tool, not woo-woo BS.** Humans don't recognize vectors; we recognize acceleration and deceleration—change, in other words. Gratitude allows us to simulate that change by comparing our current state to either a past state or a hypothetical worse circumstance. This comparison highlights our state of abundance (or if not abundance, then whatever one does have—however little—that gives them energy). This creates a boost of positive emotions similar to what we felt when we initially experienced the achievement or *level-up*. Without gratitude, we still experience this phenomenon, but inversely. We constantly compare ourselves to the projected abundance we see in the media landscape. Without gratitude, therefore, WE ARE UNBALANCED BY DEFAULT, perpetually craving. There also something to be said here about those who are born at *the top. *They are unable to create a change significant against the vastness of what they’re already born into. I suppose this makes them either overcompensate and seek massive impact at the expense of others, i.e. Zuckerburg or Trump, or sink into a lack of ownership and meaninglessness like many nameless trust fund babies. However, I’m focused on how to get out of the default imbalance that most in this country are born into psychologically and spiritually due in part to the consumer media landscape on which the most profitable business models ever created, google and facebook still rely for over 96% of their revenue. Yes Advertising is still king and was the initial use case for AI at scale, just under the name algorithm. Side note, if another person tells me not to use ChatBeepBoopBeep because it’s bad for the environment but thinks the rest of the internet runs on rainbows I’m…just going to laugh. I digress. Back to something actionable for those of us who are exposed by no fault of our own to the consumer media landscape and struggling to find the energy or will to change your circumstances after you are met with the immense and uncertain ever increasingly difficult climb in front of you. Especially as a queer or marginalized person in this fascist administration it can be crushing right now. I’ll admit that my status and solid employment are two of my main antidotes to chaos in these times. So what do you do to launch, to get that initial acceleration needed to start? **How to start ** The first thing that you must do is STOP LIVING IN REALITY. Reality is an incredibly taxing and cruel place that should only be visited as necessary. For instance, to show people that you’re not insane. Instead, you will need to remap your consciousness to get energy from the tough dry soil of the dopamine desert that is today’s late capitalist society. No matter how long or hard this is it’s scientifically proven to be possible and it’s the only thing that is 100% within your control. You’ll need to live in a world in which the world is not falling apart, in which something is growing. For me I reframe reality like this: Today we’re in the 2nd Gilded Age. A period of immense technological progress and infrastructure building, and suffering and destitution among the general population. While the old agrarian era fractured the industrial age emerged. Today the industrial era gives way to the digital era. This is a once in a century periods of deep change and turmoil. Likely this will result in starkly contrasted winners and losers. Coinciding with this, America’s place in the world is changing. We are no longer the raining hegemony, rather we’re one of a couple players exercising vast influence over our region of the globe along with our rival China. In this world, I am a player of a game of my own creation. The goal is to use available tools to leverage available opportunities. So yes, start an AI business or something awful like that. IT’S THE BEST WAY TO ENSURE THAT YOU HAVE RIGHTS IN THIS COUNTRY. Baring that, find some other way to resource yourself. Fucking believe in yourself. Get up and go. Just do it™️. You and I, we’re going to need to rent for a long time, maybe forever. Do you really want to buy a house though? It’s a lot of effort to maintain. We’re going to have to make moral compromises in order to play this next round. Unfortunately the tech oligarchs and the fascists won this one and to abstain from the new game is to lay down and rot. The value of labor is decreasing, the value of personality, charisma, leadership, grit, agency, attention seeking, improvisation, technical/CS skills including using AI to augment yourself, and the ability to function in deep ambiguity are rising rapidly. You do not need to go to college to play. It’s not really about what you want to do. It’s about what you have to do. I would encourage you to look at the sacrifices made by the previous generations in your family for you to live the life that you have regardless of where you sit in the socioeconomic ladder. The fact that you’re alive means that people did hard things and went without to get you here. I’m assuming you’re in America at least. Okay pause. You’re probably horror stricken, rushing to unfriend me. We can both agree, it’s a departure from reality. And that’s the point. What does living in reality actually do for you? Don’t loose touch! Just hold reality gently and prefer a world in which you’re the main character. It’s an underdog story and you’re faced with seemingly insurmountable challenges. TREAT IT ALL LIKE AN RPG. IT’S THE BEST ADVICE THAT I CAN GIVE. This is the only way that I’ve found to create your own reality in which you can get the initial energy boost to start from nothing and make it to a place of abundance in today’s society. Obviously if you lived like this forever you’d end up becoming another cancer cell in this dying democracy. I’m not saying that we need to live like this forever. That may ensure our wellbeing in the short term but it will not help us escape the situation that we’re in long term. For now though, we must must must stop fighting the losing battle. Go with it, right now is an opportunity to amass wealth and skills. Start out by building a program to solve a problem you face in day to day life. My friend said it best when I asked him only a couple months ago about how I should start to code. He said, “Koii, listen. You don’t have to code anymore. You just download Cursor, tell the AI what you want to build and it’s like having a private tutor for 20 bucks a month.” AI is not good at your job. But it is good at coding. Especially for small projects and for teaching you to code. It’s calibrated to doing just that. AI has always been attuned to the needs of those building it. What are their needs? Writing lines of code. That’s the epicenter of what these hundreds of billions are getting poured into. What you do, that’s on the periphery, that’s why some people rave about it and others are left wondering why everyone has lost their minds. I’m so sorry but if you don’t use this it’s like saying I don’t want to learn to read or write. In this case reading and writing is tied to the immediate destruction of the planet and the poisoning of likely millions in and around underprivileged communities breathing the polluted air from data centers like the one Musk built in Memphis. However, listen listen to me. WE LOST THE LAST ROUND. This is not a choice. Please please look out for yourself and your loved ones by UPSKILLING. I know you want to work at a plant shop. I know you want to be a political scientist. But right now we need people like you to be well resourced and highly skilled with the tools of the digital age. IF WE DO NOT GET ENOUGH HIGH CONSCIOUSNESS PEOPLE INTO THE UPPER CLASSES, IT WILL ONLY GET MORE LIKE 1984 FROM HERE. So where does gratitude come in? Look at what you have now. Parents who love you? A full tummy? A roof over your head? The world’s information in your hand? YOU ARE THE PRIVILEGED ONE. Even if you’re trans, even if you’re at the intersection of one or more oppressed groups. You are privileged. Be grateful for what you have and the people that helped you get it. We have to be defenders of those who have less. To do that we need to not be dead, imprisoned or in bondage to our own subsistence. Imagine a situation where you work 10 hours a day, 4 jobs like multiple of the uber drivers that I’ve spoken to recently. 4 jobs! To scrape by. You come home and you’re exhausted, too tired to think or feel. You’re depressed from the overwork and all around you society drains, you imbalances you by default with anti [insert your group here] propoganda. This is our hand if we do not recognize the reality we’re in and focus on putting ourselves in the best position we possibly can strategically. If we do not take the necessary steps to build resources the above will be your life. Take control. Learn the system. And for now put yourself and your community first. Palestine matters and we must continue to protest and take the steps necessary for harm reduction. But understand that if we never build an abundance within *this* system then we will always be acting reactively. Be grateful for what you have and understand that you cannot stop every bad thing from happening. It’s futile. We need to focus on pulling back the line to where we can sustain our position and live to fight another day for a more equitable future. Mark my words. Our absolutism we be our downfall. **On the other side** Now that I live a life of abundance, I am able to be far more effective than if I had practiced absolutism and gone straight for harm reduction. I would have only been able to effect one person’s worth of change. I could have been one protester, I could have been one voice, I could have been one exhausted activist spending their energy preaching to the choir while I watch my economic value deteriorate before my eyes. However, because I chose to first sink all my time into building an abundance for myself as a white passing Latina/Jewish 50% passing Trans woman, I am able to do the above AND, understand the inner workings of the system that harms so many. I’m able to make friends across the isle and debate cordially to strengthen my ideas and rhetoric. I’m able to walk into every black business that I encounter and overpay 15 dollars for a bottle of water. I’m able to buy meals for those in need without worrying about my finances. The day I got my job I wrote my nomadic buss dwelling queer friend a $500 check, no strings. I’m able to spend my time educating myself on the horrors that our society has inflicted namely upon black people. Which yes we’re going to go on a tangent: • As a whole, black people have succeeded at the game of capitalism only to have their winnings stripped from them. • Their homes literally demolished by the government in collaboration with private interests with no notice in many cases. • They’ve built black wall street only to have it firebombed by white terrorists. • They’ve made it into upperclass white neighborhoods only to have those neighborhoods marked for defunding at the expense of both black and white inhabitants until they became unlivable. • They’ve found and made love and joy where there was none and they continue to do so. • Our society has worked hard to ensure their impoverishment and inequity. Additionally, I’m able to provide deep emotional support for the members of my community who are experiencing trauma. The point is, all of this good and what harm have I caused? I’ve filled a square shaped whole in the capitalist system with my square shaped skills, a whole that someone else would have filled regardless. I argue that participation is not complicity. As evidence to this point: there are itches that cannot be scratched by outsiders. The people within the system are privileged. Most of them only want to hear the opinion of others who are privileged. So I’ve earned a voice with which to preach to the…not choir? lmao Learn to code, start a business, get a stupidly high paying job, if it is in the realm of possibility, If you can do it, then YOU CAN DO IT and you have a responsibility to. We can talk about Stonewall too if you like, Latinxs in Ag, take your pick. You are privileged. Step up to the plate. **Failure modes** *Please email me with why I’m wrong so I can learn, grow, and be less wrong. (I’m not an effective altruist) → me [at symbol] koiib [dot] com* **How is this different from De Bois’ Talented Tenth?** There was nothing wrong with the talented tenth. However, no strategy can succeed in isolation. Without this instrumental leg of the table of plural, egalitarian, pro democracy strategy, we will not win. **Rant over.** I wrote this in one go. It’s a hot take. I love you. Read on website Forwarded this email? Subscribe here

sample_results.message_content: Dear Koii,   Thank you for raising your concerns regarding the financial impact this situation has on your side. We are committed to collaborating with you to find a fair and feasible solution.   The current situation is that the goods have already been unloaded and are now under customs clearance, which is estimated to be completed between October 5–8 . After that, the goods will need to be transported to a warehouse .   Action 1 – John is doing his utmost to secure an alternative warehouse in the UK at the most competitive rates possible .   Action 2 – We understand that access to the ShipBob UK facility is blocked until your VAT / EORI number is obtained. However, could you kindly clarify the reason why the UK facility is inaccessible when it is accepted for Canada and Australia?                     Based on our understanding and a check with ChatGPT, if there is no VAT number when importing to the UK, import VAT cannot be reclaimed until a valid VAT number is available.                     Once the VAT number is registered and valid, you will be able to submit the necessary documentation to reclaim the import VAT that was paid during customs clearance.                     What is the impact for ShipBob without EORI/VAT?   Could you also provide the expected timeline for obtaining your VAT/EORI number? How confident are you that you can secure both by October 24?   As mentioned in the email thread titled " BATCH 2025-07 SHIPMENT AND DOCUMENT ," following points are mentioned : the charges in the UK are higher. the "temporary storage arrangement" is intended only for the short term. Additionally, we have suggested considering holding the shipment at the factory until these two numbers are secured to avoid incurring further costs. But it hasn’t been considered. We had expected from this email thread that both numbers would be obtained by September .  In our previous email on July 31, we requested that if these numbers were received by September 13, there would be no need for temporary storage in the UK. Since there is no reply for this that we assumed these numbers are obtained in Sept. Therefore, we haven’t quoted for it. However, we do not expect to use the AU19/day rate as a reference, as it applies only to Australia.   As a valued partner, John is committed to assisting with the financial impact. Let's collaborate on the actions outlined above to reach a fair and feasible solution. We aim to provide an update on Action 1 by tomorrow. We appreciate your understanding and continued support.     Thanks with best regards Fionn Ng ******************************* MGM Industries & Co. Tel :   (852) 2545 0375 Fax :  (852) 2541 0362   From: Koii Benvenutto <koii@trassgames.com> Sent: Thursday, October 2, 2025 5:12 AM To: Fionn Ng <fionnng@mgmproduction.com.hk> Cc: jayshay <jayshay@trassgames.com>; John Chiu <johnchiu@mgmproduction.com.hk>; Steve Shockey <steve@trassgames.com> Subject: Re: BATCH 2025-07 UK SHIPMENT ETA SHIPBOB WAREHOUSE ON SEPT 5 2025   Dear Fionn, Thank you for your prompt reply. Let's work together and align on a solution. Our access to the ShipBob location is currently blocked due to the lagging UK tax registration process so storing the goods at the ShipBob location is not an option at this time. The £572/day storage rate is unworkable for us. This translates to over $23,000 USD over the next month—a cost we did not anticipate and cannot absorb. When we agreed to temporary storage, our only reference was the ~$19 AUD/day rate in Australia. We view this as a partnership, and we understand you have operational costs to cover. However, moving forward, we need transparency on the possibility of significant costs like this one, especially when they are this far outside the benchmark. Let's solve this together. As a starting point: Is there a fair one-time rate you can offer us that covers your essential costs while we arrange to move the goods ASAP? We trust your expertise. Please recommend a more suitable, cost-effective storage facility to which we can transfer the inventory. This is a learning opportunity for our team especially on international logistics. We will ensure our planning is tighter in the future. I can give you my word on that. And we ask for more proactive communication on any potential high-cost scenarios from your side. I look forward to your prompt reply. Best, Koii   Koii Benvenutto PM Plush and Merch koii@trassgames.com
